feature_notes.length: Mean hole length from the mapped playing lines (tee to green, back tees), yards per hole
feature_notes.par: Total par scaled to 18 holes (only where every hole's par is mapped)
feature_notes.water: Share of holes with a water hazard within 25 m of the playing line
feature_notes.trees: Share of the course under tree cover (ESA WorldCover 10 m)
feature_notes.views: Line-of-sight sea and lake views (30 m surface model, out to 6 km) from the tees and greens: 90th percentile over them
feature_notes.relief: Elevation range across the course (2nd–98th percentile), m
feature_notes.climb: Metres climbed per km walked, tee to green to next tee (counts against: walkability)

courses.name: Point Grey Golf & Country Club
courses.provisional_note: Provisional: OpenStreetMap has this course's outline but only 0 of ~18 holes. Estimated from the outline: sea and lake views, tree cover, relief, climb, number of holes (from its area). Not known without the holes, so left out with the weights rescaled: hole length, par, bunkers and water in play. Tested on the 33 fully mapped courses, the method is off by 9 points on average and lands within one tier 91% of the time.
